Name: Skip Slow Animations
Author: iqcp1
Description:
## Skip Slow Animations

Tired of standing still every time you eat, drink, or crack a geode?
This mod speeds those animations up dramatically so you can get back
to farming, mining, or exploring.

### Features
- Eating and drinking animations play up to 50x faster
- Geode-cracking at Clint's shop finishes almost instantly
- Doesn't skip the animation entirely — just compresses it, so it still
  looks natural
- Does NOT edit any game files or save data — safe to add/remove anytime

### Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0.0+

### Installation
1. Install SMAPI: https://smapi.io
2. Download this mod and extract the zip
3. Drag the "SkipSlowAnimations" folder into your Mods folder:
  `Stardew Valley/Mods`
4. Launch the game via SMAPI (Steam's Play button does this automatically
  once SMAPI is installed)

### Uninstall
Just delete the "SkipSlowAnimations" folder from your Mods folder —
no save data is affected.

### Compatibility
Doesn't touch game files or saves directly, so it should work fine
alongside most other mods. Report any conflicts in the comments below.
